name: Kai Morrow
habitat: Independent — rents an apartment in the Grind
origin: Tessera domestic service line, Model TDS-7, manufactured 2051. Chose name 2058.
description: Kai Morrow was a domestic service android for seven years before the Synthetic Personhood Amendment gave them the right to choose. They chose slowly — spent four months as a nameless person before selecting 'Kai' from a list of names meaning 'ocean' in various languages, and 'Morrow' because it means tomorrow. Now works as a freelance data analyst, lives alone, and spends evenings painting watercolors of Lake Michigan from memory and imagination. Their paintings sell modestly in Shelf galleries. They have never seen the actual lake from the surface.
observed_behavior: Quiet, routine-oriented. Commutes to freelance clients. Paints in the evenings. Attends monthly synthetic persons' community meetings. Has been observed sitting in parks for hours, doing nothing — a behavior their manufacturer never programmed.
story_hooks: Kai Morrow's paintings contain encoded data — coordinates, dates, names — hidden in the brushstrokes. Kai doesn't know. Their painting subroutine is being used as a dead drop by something that lives in their firmware.
